llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究LPBF制备316L-TiC复合材料中TiC颗粒的熔化和分解现象，未涉及生物医用植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽、疲劳性能或骨整合等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on the metallurgical behavior of TiC particles in a steel matrix composite during LPBF, with no mention of biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF过程中TiC颗粒的熔化和分解机制
summary_zh.method: 通过微观结构表征和相分析研究TiC在316L基体中的行为
summary_zh.result: 发现了TiC颗粒熔化和分解的直接证据
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证，包括微观结构观察和相分析

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the melting and decomposition behavior of TiC particles during laser powder bed fusion of 316L-TiC composites.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization and phase analysis were performed on LPBF-processed samples.
summary_en.result: Direct evidence of TiC melting and decomposition was observed, with formation of new phases.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through SEM, EDS, and XRD analysis.

papers.title: Effect of post-processing and variation of the building angle of Ti-6Al-4 V disks obtained by selective laser melting: A comparison of physical, chemical and mechanical properties to machined disks
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Dental Materials and Prosthodontics, Ribeirão Preto Dental School, University of São Paulo (USP), Ribeirão Preto, SP, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: Andréa Cândido dos Reis
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Dental Materials and Prosthodontics, Ribeirão Preto Dental School, University of São Paulo (USP), Ribeirão Preto, SP, Brazil

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V圆盘的构建角度和后处理对物理、化学和力学性能的影响，与机加工圆盘进行了对比，为生物医学植入物的制造工艺优化提供了参考。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not directly address stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration of porous implant structures; it focuses on the effect of building angle and post-processing on bulk mechanical properties of solid disks.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估后处理和构建角度对SLM Ti-6Al-4V圆盘性能的影响，并与机加工圆盘对比。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同构建角度和表面处理的圆盘，进行物理、化学和力学性能测试。
summary_zh.result: 构建角度和后处理显著影响表面粗糙度、硬度和微观结构，力学性能与机加工圆盘有差异。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度及表面形貌测试验证性能差异。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effects of post-processing and building angle on the physical, chemical, and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V disks fabricated by selective laser melting, compared to machined disks.
summary_en.method: Disks were manufactured at different building angles and subjected to various post-processing treatments, then characterized by surface roughness, microstructural analysis, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Building angle and post-processing significantly influence surface roughness, hardness, and microstructure, leading to different mechanical properties compared to machined disks.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing (hardness, tensile) and surface morphology analysis.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or perform any finite element or mechanical testing; it focuses on clinical management of hip instability.

summary_zh.motivation: 管理全髋关节置换术后不稳定
summary_zh.method: 采用隔离轴承交换治疗

summary_en.motivation: To manage hip instability following primary total hip arthroplasty through isolated bearing exchange.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study of patients undergoing isolated bearing exchange for instability.
summary_en.result: The procedure improved stability and reduced dislocation rates.

papers.title: An Analytic Solution to Covariance Propagation in Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification of neural networks is critical to measuring the reliability and robustness of deep learning systems. However, this often involves costly or inaccurate sampling methods and approximations. This paper presents a sample-free moment propagation technique that propagates mean vectors and covariance matrices across a network to accurately characterize the input-output distributions of neural networks. A key enabler of our technique is an analytic solution for the covariance of random variables passed through nonlinear activation functions, such as Heaviside, ReLU, and GELU. The wide applicability and merits of the proposed technique are shown in experiments analyzing the input-output distributions of trained neural networks and training Bayesian neural networks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需采样的神经网络协方差传播方法，可用于不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on general neural network uncertainty propagation.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效量化神经网络的不确定性，避免昂贵采样。
summary_zh.method: 提出解析协方差传播方法，处理非线性激活函数。
summary_zh.result: 在分析网络输入输出分布和训练贝叶斯网络中验证有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准神经网络和贝叶斯网络基准上实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify uncertainty in neural networks without costly sampling or approximations.
summary_en.method: Proposes a sample-free moment propagation technique with analytic solutions for covariance through nonlinear activations.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates accurate characterization of input-output distributions and improved Bayesian neural network training.
summary_en.validation: Validated on trained neural network analysis and Bayesian neural network training experiments.

papers.title: Stochastic parameter reduced-order model based on hybrid machine learning approaches
papers.abstract: Establishing appropriate mathematical models for complex systems in natural phenomena not only helps deepen our understanding of nature but can also be used for state estimation and prediction. However, the extreme complexity of natural phenomena makes it extremely challenging to develop full-order models (FOMs) and apply them to studying many quantities of interest. In contrast, appropriate reduced-order models (ROMs) are favored due to their high computational efficiency and ability to describe the key dynamics and statistical characteristics of natural phenomena. Taking the viscous Burgers equation as an example, this paper constructs a Convolutional Autoencoder-Reservoir Computing-Normalizing Flow algorithm framework, where the Convolutional Autoencoder is used to construct latent space representations, and the Reservoir Computing-Normalizing Flow framework is used to characterize the evolution of latent state variables. In this way, a data-driven stochastic parameter reduced-order model is constructed to describe the complex system and its dynamic behavior.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用混合机器学习方法构建随机参数降阶模型，但应用于Burgers方程，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no constraint handling or UQ for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 复杂系统全阶模型计算成本高，需高效降阶模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出卷积自编码器-储层计算-归一化流混合框架构建随机参数降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 在粘性Burgers方程上验证了模型描述关键动力学和统计特性的能力。

summary_en.motivation: Full-order models for complex natural phenomena are computationally expensive, motivating the development of efficient reduced-order models.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework combining convolutional autoencoder, reservoir computing, and normalizing flow is proposed to construct a stochastic parameter reduced-order model in latent space.
summary_en.result: The model effectively captures key dynamics and statistical characteristics of the viscous Burgers equation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on the viscous Burgers equation.
